title: Reef Snorkel Adventure at Sombrero Key Light Reef
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
The ability to swim is necessary in order to participate in the snorkeling activity.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover the vibrant underwater ecosystem of the Florida Keys on a Reef Snorkel Adventure to the renowned Sombrero Key Light Reef. Aboard the luxurious Marathon Mermaid, glide through the crystal-clear waters for an unforgettable snorkeling experience. This 3-hour excursion invites all ages to explore the colorful coral and diverse marine life, guided by a knowledgeable crew dedicated to your safety and enjoyment. After your underwater exploration, relax on the return trip while savoring fresh fruit and refreshing beverages, reminiscing about the aquatic wonders you’ve encountered.
